 Supreme Court Collegium Recommends Appointment Of 5 Judicial Officers As Judges Of Madhya Pradesh High Court
 Jayanti Pahwa 
 30 Oct 2026 7:03 PM IST
 Share this 
 Listen to this Article The Supreme Court Collegium, at its meeting held on October 30, 2026, has recommended the appointment of 5 judicial officers as Judges of the Madhya Pradesh High Court. 
 The statement reads, "The Supreme Court Collegium, in its meeting held on 30th October 2026, has approved the proposal for appointment of the following Judicial Officers, as Judges of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh". The judicial officers recommended for appointment are 
 Smt. Renuka Kanchan
 Shri Krishnamurty Mishra
 Shri Virendra Singh Rajput
 Smt. Mamta Jain
 Smt. Ashita Shrivastava
